name: Rippling
description_en:
Rippling is a modular workforce platform spanning HR, payroll, IT and finance. Its HRIS provides a shared employee-data foundation, documents, time-off policies, self-service, permissions and workflow automation, while other products are selected separately.

Its practical value should be evaluated through changes in employee attributes and the processes those changes trigger. The advertised starting price is not a total payroll or IT suite price: product selection, employee count and monthly base fees affect the quote.
description_zh:
Rippling 是跨 HR、工资、IT 和财务的模块化人员平台。其 HRIS 提供共享员工数据基础、文档、休假政策、自助、权限及流程自动化，其他产品分别选择。

实际评估应围绕员工属性变化及其触发的流程展开。宣传起价不是完整工资或 IT 套件总价，所选产品、员工数及月度基础费都会影响报价。

core_features.explanation_en: The HRIS page describes shared employee data and changes such as manager or department updating across the platform.
core_features.explanation_zh: HRIS 页面描述共享员工数据，以及经理或部门变更在平台内更新。

core_features.explanation_en: Configure what each person can access and do, and build policies around company rules.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可配置各人能访问和执行的内容，并按企业规则建立政策。

core_features.explanation_en: Use triggers and actions with Rippling or connected-app data, and build reports with role-based visibility.
core_features.explanation_zh: 可用 Rippling 或已连接应用数据触发动作，并以角色权限控制报表可见性。

pricing.summary_en: Starts at $8/employee/month plus an unspecified monthly base fee; selected products determine total. Custom quote needed, with conditional six-month US startup program.
pricing.summary_zh: 每员工每月 8 美元起，另有未披露月度基础费，总价取决于产品。需定制报价，特定美国初创企业有六个月优惠计划。

official_check.scope: Public primary sources read; no account, purchase, integration execution, performance benchmark, owner identity or publication approval tested.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: Define which employee data drives action
sections.title_zh: 定义哪些员工数据驱动操作
sections.en: Rippling’s HRIS describes one employee-data foundation and automatic updates when attributes such as manager or department change. Onboarding, documents, PTO policies, signatures and self-service are presented around that foundation. For an illustrative transfer, verify the department value, reporting manager, PTO approver and the reports visible to each role. Decide who may make the change and its effective date before automating consequences. The advertised reduction in manual work is a vendor proposition; no synchronization latency, error rate or customer productivity was measured in this research.
sections.zh: Rippling HRIS 描述统一员工数据基础，并称经理或部门等属性变化会自动更新。入职、文档、休假政策、签名及自助围绕该基础提供。调动示例可检查部门、汇报经理、休假审批人和各角色可见报表。自动化后果之前，应明确谁能修改及何时生效。减少人工操作属于供应商主张，本研究未测量同步延迟、错误率或客户生产率。

sections.title_en: Demonstrate a trigger and its failure path
sections.title_zh: 演示触发器及失败路径
sections.en: The product page describes workflows using data from Rippling or connected applications, with actions ranging from welcome emails to security alerts. Permissions, policies and analytics are related platform tools. A useful acceptance case is an employee joining a department: inspect the trigger, intended recipients and access boundaries, then introduce a missing field or disconnected destination. Confirm duplicate prevention, retries and human escalation rather than assuming a broad automation claim covers those cases. The reviewed marketing page does not establish the exact workflow limits or every connector’s supported direction.
sections.zh: 产品页描述可使用 Rippling 或连接应用的数据建立流程，动作包括欢迎邮件及安全提醒，并有相关权限、政策及分析工具。验收可用员工加入部门：检查触发条件、预定接收人和权限边界，再加入缺失字段或目标断开。需确认去重、重试和人工升级，不能假定广泛的自动化宣传已覆盖这些情况。所读营销页未确立具体流程上限或每个连接器的支持方向。

sections.title_en: Keep HRIS separate from adjacent services
sections.title_zh: 区分 HRIS 与相邻服务
sections.en: Rippling lists Time & Attendance, Payroll, PEO, HR Services, Performance and Recruiting as additional HR products, and its wider navigation contains device and identity management, finance and employer-of-record services. A connected platform is not evidence that all of these are bundled. For example, automating a hire through device shipping requires the relevant IT products and operational arrangements, not just an employee record. Broad compliance coverage claims should be mapped to an actual country, worker category and purchased service; this research did not validate filings, employment contracts or regulatory outcomes.
sections.zh: Rippling 将考勤、工资、PEO、HR 服务、绩效和招聘列为其他 HR 产品，更广导航还包含设备与身份管理、财务及名义雇主服务。互联平台不证明全部打包。例如把录用自动衔接至设备寄送，需相应 IT 产品和运营安排，仅有员工档案不够。广泛的合规覆盖说法需对应具体国家、人员类别和所购服务，本研究未验证申报、雇佣合同或监管结果。

sections.title_en: A starting rate leaves a base fee and modules
sections.title_zh: 起价之外还有基础费与模块
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says plans start at $8 per employee per month with a monthly base fee, and total cost depends on selected products and services. It also says most products use per-employee monthly pricing while some may include a base fee. Neither the base amount nor a complete HRIS or payroll bundle was disclosed. For 50 employees, $400 is only the arithmetic of the advertised starting rate before the unspecified base fee and chosen products; it is not a usable final quote. Eligible US venture-backed startups may receive six months free, subject to funding status and stage. This limited program is not a general sustained free plan.
sections.zh: 价格 FAQ 称套餐每员工每月 8 美元起，另有月度基础费，总成本取决于所选产品和服务；又说明多数产品按员工月度计费，部分可能含基础费。页面未披露基础费金额或完整 HRIS、工资组合价。50 名员工的 400 美元仅为宣传起价的算术，尚未加未明基础费及所选产品，不能作为最终报价。符合条件的美国风投支持初创企业可能获六个月免费，取决于融资状态和阶段，这不是普遍可长期使用的免费套餐。

sections.title_en: Reconcile a transition before expanding automation
sections.title_zh: 扩展自动化前核对迁移
sections.en: The pricing FAQ says Rippling can import and analyze year-to-date payroll data during a provider switch, including mid-year. Treat that as a migration capability to scope, not a guarantee that historical amounts reconcile automatically. Prepare employee identifiers, year-to-date balances, policies and role ownership; compare a parallel pay period and test a corrected employee record. Rippling is relevant when coordinated HR and adjacent operations justify modular costs and configuration. Signed terms, hosting, complete exports, recovery, connector failure handling and source-code licensing remain unverified. No account, payroll, device shipment or AI action was executed.
sections.zh: 价格 FAQ 称切换供应商时可导入分析当年累计工资数据，包括年中迁移。这是需要明确范围的迁移能力，不保证历史金额自动对平。需准备员工编号、当年累计余额、政策及角色责任，比较一期并行工资并测试档案更正。当 HR 与相邻运营协同足以支撑模块成本和配置投入时，Rippling 值得评估。签署条款、托管、完整导出、恢复、连接器失败处理及源代码许可仍未核实，未执行账户、工资、设备寄送或 AI 操作。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Hypothetical examples are not executed tests.

research_gaps.en: No account, workflow, connector, payroll or AI action was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行账户、流程、连接器、工资或 AI 操作。

research_gaps.en: Base fee, product entitlements, contract, regional scope, hosting, export and failure recovery remain unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 基础费、产品权益、合同、地区范围、托管、导出及失败恢复仍未核实。
